BiblicalUsage: Meshillemith is a priest in the line of Immer, named once in the register. 1 Chronicles 9:12 traces Maasiai through Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that being named once among the priests who served is honour enough: Meshillemith stood in the line, and the line is what God remembered.
